chapter_title: General Provisions Regarding Imports and Exports
title: Import under Govt. to Govt. Agreements

business_rules.rule_description:
2.45 Import under Govt. to Govt. Agreements
Import of goods under Government-to-Government agreements may be allowed
without an Authorisation on production of necessary evidence to satisfaction of
Customs authorities.
